subject: Important Update on Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, We are writing to inform you about a recent update to our online account system. To enhance security measures, we have implemented a new two-factor authentication process. You will now be required to verify your identity using a code sent to your registered email or phone number. Please ensure your contact details are up to date to avoid any disruptions in accessing your account. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Best regards, Customer Support Team
